name: Amoonguss (CobbleEffort form)
look: a big screw mushroom: a broad steel Phillips-head cap over a hex nut collar, a stout white body with swirly eyes and a wide grin, two long threaded screw arms and copper feet
entry: It screws itself deep into rock with its two threaded arms and stays there for years. Old mines are held up by colonies of them, and a miner who pulls one out may bring the tunnel down.
how: Wild: rare in caves deep underground and in abandoned mineshafts.
